name: dream2fly-backend
description: Dream2Fly Consulting — backend API (auth, leads, tasks, users) matching the Employee Dashboard v1.0 prototype

scripts.start:legacy: npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node src/index.js
scripts.prisma:baseline: mkdir -p prisma/migrations/0_init && npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script > prisma/migrations/0_init/migration.sql && npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 0_init
scripts.prisma:deploy: npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy
